stem: Which inference about the actual moon landing do details from the story “Moon Landing” and the poem “The Apollo 11 Moon Landing” BOTH support?

options.label: A
options.text: The dust on the moon is dangerous for astronauts.

options.label: B
options.text: The scene on the moon is dull and dreary.

options.label: C
options.text: The astronauts have difficulty moving in their spacesuits.

options.label: D
options.text: The surface of the moon appears lifeless and still.
